lines.text: Herod hears people say Jesus is John the Baptist risen from the dead, or Elijah, or a prophet.
Herod had John arrested and imprisoned because John said it was not lawful for him to marry his uncle's wife Herodias.
Herodias wanted John dead, but Herod feared John, protected him, and listened to him gladly.
At Herod's birthday banquet, the daughter of Herodias danced, and Herod swore to give her anything up to half his kingdom, so she asked her mother.
The girl asked for John's head on a platter, and Herod was angry but sent an executioner, and John's disciples laid his body in a tomb.

wrong_details.true: The king was consumed with sorrow
